text.p: Bristol-Myers Squibb Co said Wednesday that it has a licensing agreement to obtain exclusive rights to Progenics Pharmaceuticals Inc's GMK and MGV cancer vaccines.
GMK is a vaccine for the treatment of malignant melanoma, the deadliest form of skin cancer.
MGV is a vaccine being developed to treat a variety of other tumor types.
Under the terms of the agreement, Bristol-Myers Squibb obtains an exclusive license worldwide for the GMK and MGV vaccines and will support the clinical development and marketing of the vaccines.
Bristol-Myers Squibb will provide up-front and milestone payments to Progenics as well as royalty payments after marketing.
Financial terms of the agreement were not disclosed.
